newsitem.title: CONGO: SOCCER-CONGO FACE WORLD CUP FORFEIT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CONGO FACE WORLD CUP FORFEIT.

text.p: Congo may be forced to forfeit their next World Cup qualifier because of a dispute over money owed to the African Football Confederation.

The confederation has given Congo's national federation until January 10 to pay the membership arrears, estimated at 20 million CFA francs ($38,000), or be banned from playing their January 12 Africa zone match against Zaire, a government official said on Saturday.
It was not immediately clear how the points within group three would be distributed. Zambia and South Africa are the other teams involved.
